findings.problem: unchecked slice indexing `&buf[start..end]` panics when start > buf.len() or end > buf.len() instead of returning a typed error
findings.failure_mode: invalid offset/len from untrusted caller causes panic instead of graceful error; no bounds proof exists before the indexing operation
findings.fix: replace with `buf.get(start..end).ok_or(Error::OutOfBounds)` or similar checked access that returns a typed Result

findings.problem: `start + len as usize` performs unchecked usize arithmetic that can overflow; `offset as usize` truncates u32 to usize without proof the value fits
findings.failure_mode: malformed u32 offset/len causes arithmetic overflow in usize domain leading to panic or incorrect slice bounds
findings.fix: use checked arithmetic: `offset.checked_add(len).and_then(|end| buf.get(start..end))` or validate bounds before indexing

findings.problem: production-reachable code uses bare slice indexing that can panic on invalid input
findings.failure_mode: any caller passing offset/len outside valid range causes panic instead of typed error; this function appears to be a library API for windowed buffer access
findings.fix: replace panicking indexing with Result-returning checked access

findings.problem: no benchmark, profiler, or assembly evidence exists to validate the performance claim implicit in returning a slice reference vs. a safer API shape
findings.failure_mode: performance optimization without measurement is speculation; the API shape may not be the fastest allowable form
findings.fix: add criterion benchmark measuring this function under realistic workloads and record baseline numbers

findings.problem: function returns &[u8] with no mechanism for caller to distinguish valid window from invalid/empty window when offset/len are at buffer boundary
findings.failure_mode: caller cannot determine whether a zero-length window is a valid result or an error condition without additional context
findings.fix: return Result<&[u8], Error> to make boundary conditions explicit and handleable

no profiler evidence for hot-path shape
no assembly/IR evidence for bounds-check elimination
